root_cause: Only the Python/CPU variant of model_creation_sample (test[param3]) failed out of 208 smoke tests; the identical C++/CPU and other Python variants (MULTI:CPU, AUTO) passed. samples_common_test_class.py logs stderr via log.error(stderr) only when retcode != 0, but the captured log shows an empty ERROR line with no message body, meaning the subprocess produced no stderr text despite a non-zero return code. This pattern (isolated single-parametrization failure, no diagnostic output, surrounding identical variants pass) is consistent with a transient runner-level issue (e.g., the python3 subprocess being killed/OOM-killed or racing with another process on the ARM64 host) rather than a deterministic code defect introduced by the HSM import/export PR, which does not touch the samples or Python sample scripts.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI. To attempt locally on a Linux ARM64 host after building/installing OpenVINO with samples: `python3 install/samples/python/model_creation_sample/model_creation_sample.py install/samples/cpp/model_creation_sample/lenet.bin CPU` and check the return code; run the full smoke suite with `pytest install/tests/smoke_tests -k test_model_creation_sample` repeatedly to try to reproduce intermittent failure.
recommended_actions: Re-run the Samples job / workflow to confirm whether the failure reproduces (if it does not reproduce on rerun, this strengthens the Flaky Test / Infrastructure classification).

Enhance samples_common_test_class.py to always log subprocess stdout in addition to stderr on failure, and to log the retcode value itself, so future failures carry actionable diagnostics instead of an empty ERROR line.
Check ARM64 self-hosted/GitHub-hosted runner resource usage (memory/CPU) during the Samples job window (09:23 UTC) for signs of OOM or contention.
Confirm the PR under test (#39251, CPU HSM import/export support) does not touch samples or Python sample scripts; if confirmed unrelated, do not block the PR on this failure.
prevention_strategies: Capture and log both stdout and stderr (and the retcode) unconditionally on sample test failures so intermittent runner-level issues can be distinguished from real regressions without needing to re-run with extra instrumentation. Consider adding a bounded automatic retry for isolated single-parametrization smoke test failures when all other parametrizations of the same sample pass, to reduce noise from transient runner issues while still surfacing systematic failures.
historical_context: No prior occurrences of this exact test/sample failure signature were found in the post-commit investigation or pattern databases; this is the first recorded instance of a model_creation_sample.py Python/CPU smoke test failure. Other recent ARM64 Samples-related issues (e.g., invalid-pch cross-compilation build errors) are a different root cause (toolchain/build, not test execution) and are tracked under a separate pattern.
